guidetextdraw_648300027._value:
Instructions:

You are requesting a final term extension to the State University Grant. Please submit the following: 

  1. State University Grant Appeal Form
  2.  Documentation of final term (Written confirmation or the equivalent from a Graduation Specialist or Major Advisor)

Appeal Process:  

Appeals are reviewed by the Office of Financial Aid. Please allow 2-3 weeks for your appeal to be reviewed. We will e-mail the decision to your campus e-mail address. If approved, we will extend the State University Grant for one final term. If you do not graduate after the term your appeal was granted you will not be eligible to appeal again.
